scope: SEARCH-03 full snapshot rebuild, incremental cursor catchup, and atomic index alias cutover (including SEARCH-03-R1 hardening)

endpoints: GET /internal/v1/content/article-snapshots/{snapshotId} (page 1 omits cursor, subsequent pages use nextCursor)
contentSnapshotClient.http410Handling: Marks current candidate job EXPIRED_SUPERSEDED, preserves active serving alias, creates replacement job with new clientRequestId and candidate_generation + 1
contentSnapshotClient.http401Handling: Invalidates cached service token for (knode-content, content:snapshot:read) and retries

tables.search_index_generation: Per-alias active_generation, active_physical_index, cutover_state (NORMAL|CUTOVER_PAUSED|SWITCHING_ALIAS), active_rebuild_job_id, require_cold_visibility_guard, and cutover cache invalidation compensation state
tables.search_article_version_barrier: Cross-generation monotonic max_content_revision and last_visibility floor preventing late pre-cutover resurrection
tables.search_rebuild_job: Resumable rebuild checkpoint and lease state with UNIQUE(active_lock_key), monotonic lease_generation fencing token, and alias_switch_uncertain state enforcing single-owner non-overlapping writebacks per alias across instances
tables.search_rebuild_event_log: Rebuild-scoped idempotency log keyed by (candidate_generation, event_id), isolated from active search_event_inbox
tables.search_article_projection: Composite PK (index_generation, article_id) isolating candidate projection from active generation
tables.search_index_task: Composite PK (index_generation, article_id) with immutable target_index binding every worker write strictly to its task generation's physical index

stateMachine.leaseFencing: Every post-IO local SQL writeback locks search_rebuild_job FOR UPDATE first and verifies lease_owner, monotonic lease_generation, lease_until_ms > now, expected phase, and input snapshot/incremental cursor before mutating projections, tasks, event logs, cursors, or phase; stale instances abort with StaleRebuildLeaseException and roll back cleanly
stateMachine.commitBatchAtomicity: All events in a ChangeCommitBatch and the updated incremental_cursor commit in one SQL transaction; mid-batch failure rolls back the full batch leaving incremental_cursor unchanged
stateMachine.zeroGapEventHandoff: CUTOVER_PAUSING sets search_index_generation.cutover_state=CUTOVER_PAUSED under row lock; ContentEventIngestionService rejects online commits with CutoverPausedException without XACKing Stream entries; SearchIndexTaskWorker stops claiming online tasks; FINAL_CATCHUP drains all commits up to observed head strictly after pause; once SWITCHING_ALIAS completes and resets cutover_state=NORMAL, unacked post-cutover Stream events resume on active_generation=candidate_generation
stateMachine.coldArticleProtection: After rebuild cutover sets require_cold_visibility_guard=1, any online PublicArticleEvent for an article without a projection in the active generation and above search_article_version_barrier performs a fail-closed authoritative Content visibility:batch (PUBLIC_SEARCH) check outside the SQL transaction: denied/deleted articles persist a durable hidden version barrier; PUBLIC/READABLE responses strictly compare event sourceRevision against authoritative sourceRevision (event < authoritative -> STALE_IGNORED without marking authoritative revision applied; event > authoritative or missing authoritative revision -> retryable failure without XACK; exact equality -> admitted)

atomicAliasCutoverAndCache.preSwitchVerification: Explicit ES refresh of candidate physical index, exact searchable=true/false document count equality against candidate projection, and sampled search-path (_search by ids with version=true) verification of public fields and tombstone field redaction
atomicAliasCutoverAndCache.reconcileFirstRecovery: Persists SWITCHING_ALIAS intent and alias_switch_uncertain=1 before ES POST /_aliases; every remove action carries must_exist=true so stale/duplicate switches cannot re-attach old indices; strictly validates acknowledged=true, errors!=true, and per-action results on HTTP 2xx and verifies GET /_alias/{alias} points solely to candidatePhysicalIndex before activation. Timeouts, IO drops, HTTP 408/5xx, unacknowledged, or partial failures keep SWITCHING_ALIAS and reconcile against authoritative ES alias state (never reverting to NORMAL on a single GET still showing sourcePhysicalIndex); partial dual bindings ({source, candidate}) atomically remove stale bindings via must_exist=true; only synchronous pre-switch HTTP 4xx (!=408) rejections with source intact revert to NORMAL
atomicAliasCutoverAndCache.lateOldWorkerIsolation: Workers bind target_index from search_index_task at claim time; late in-flight g1 writes target only g1 and skip active cache epoch invalidation when task.indexGeneration != active_generation
atomicAliasCutoverAndCache.cacheEpochHandoff: Writes durable Redis cutover bypass marker knode:<env>:v1:search:cutover_bypass BEFORE ES POST /_aliases; while set, all query instances (including restarted instances, with zero DB dependency) bypass stale pre-cutover Redis cache reads (including empty-result cache) and writebacks and query ES via the active alias directly. Only after Redis INCR on knode:<env>:v1:search:epoch succeeds does SearchCacheInvalidator delete cutover_bypass; if INCR fails, cutover_bypass stays active until compensation completes

verificationBoundary.verifiedInJvm: Loopback HTTP Content snapshot/changes & visibility stubs, stateful loopback Elasticsearch HTTP stub (indices/refresh/alias/_aliases with must_exist/_search/version=external, timeout/partial-failure/late-arrival simulation), H2 MODE=MySQL fresh + SEARCH-02->SEARCH-03 + SEARCH-03->SEARCH-03-R1 upgrade DDL, simulated Redis Stream & cache epoch/bypass stores, and real KnodeSearchApplication Spring Boot context wiring
verificationBoundary.notVerifiedLocally: Live Elasticsearch cluster shard routing/network partitions, live MySQL InnoDB deadlock contention, live Redis Cluster failover, and live knode-content/knode-auth end-to-end integration
